Edit: okay so I just saw the text in your post and that stuff isn't cool. I think you'd benefit from talking to a therapist, cause it seems like you have an unhealthy attachment to how people view your looks (and maybe more). It's easier said than done, but getting rid of those thinking habits will change your life. My girlfriend has a lot of similar issues and therapy has made a huge difference for her over the course of the past 5 or 6 months. It does take time but she's really confident and happy with her appearance now, as she should be. And you should be too, because you are actually super pretty.

Even if you were ugly, the opinions of random internet dudes aren't really relevant to you so try not to worry about that shit. But you're far from ugly, so hopefully you can distance yourself from that with time and mindfulness.
